title: Prof-K: Probabilistic One-Pass Filtering for Efficient Top-k Selection
abstract: arXiv:2608.12573v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Top-k selection is a fundamental computational primitive with applications spanning databases, information retrieval, signal processing, and modern machine learning workloads, including sparse activations and attention pruning. As data sizes grow, existing approaches become inefficient: exact methods incur high memory and compute overhead, while approximate methods often rely on brittle heuristics that degrade under adversarial or heavy-tailed inputs. In this paper, we introduce Prof-K, a fast, scalable, and distribution-agnostic top-k algorithm with probabilistic correctness guarantees. Prof-K performs a single-pass filtering procedure: a small random sample estimates an adaptive threshold, the N input elements are streamed once into a compact buffer, and an exact top-k routine on this buffer recovers the true top-k elements with probability at least 1 - $\epsilon$, where $\epsilon$ > 0 is user specified. translated_title: Prof-K：用于高效Top-k选择的概率单遍过滤方法
translated_abstract: 摘要：Top-k选择是一种基础计算原语，广泛应用于数据库、信息检索、信号处理以及现代机器学习工作负载（包括稀疏激活和注意力剪枝）中。随着数据规模的增长，现有方法变得效率低下：精确方法带来高内存和计算开销，而近似方法通常依赖脆弱的启发式规则，在面对对抗性或重尾分布输入时性能下降。在本文中，我们介绍了Prof-K，一种快速、可扩展且与分布无关的Top-k算法，具有概率正确性保证。Prof-K执行单遍过滤过程：一个小型随机样本估计自适应阈值，N个输入元素被流式处理一次进入紧凑缓冲区，然后对该缓冲区执行精确Top-k例程，以至少1 - $\epsilon$的概率恢复真正的Top-k元素，其中$\epsilon$ > 0由用户指定。我们推导出高概率保证。
tldr: Prof-K提出了一种基于随机采样和单遍过滤的Top-k选择算法，通过概率正确性保证在任意分布下实现高效、可扩展的近似选择。
en_tdlr: Prof-K introduces a probabilistic single-pass filtering algorithm for top-k selection, achieving efficient and scalable approximate results with correctness guarantees under arbitrary distributions.
